bio: This white house styled after a masseria in Puglia is sited within East Coast Park. The sprawling lawn, spectacular ocean views and sound of the waves all exude a soothing vibe. The Pugliese chef is keen to bring authentic cuisine from his homeland to Singapore, of which focaccina and pasta made from scratch are the highlights. Try his San Marzano tomato focaccina with mozzarella and fresh basil, bursting with intense flavours....
